meta.title: Fisch baits data
notes: Rows come from the current Template:Baits list transcluded on the Fisch Wiki Baits page.
The template has 66 row entries, but Umbrella appears twice with matching stats; this dataset stores 65 unique bait cards.
The Baits page stat tables mention additional stat-only bait names not present in the rendered Baits List; those were not added as catalog cards without full row/list support.
Item images are collected under /Fisch/Baits/ from Fisch Wiki/Fandom source files.
